description: A Maven project named 'debug-logic-error' has been loaded in IntelliJ IDEA at ~/IdeaProjects/debug-logic-error/. The project contains a BinarySearch class with two methods: search() and countInRange(). When you run the test suite (BinarySearchTest), several tests fail — specifically, tests that search for elements that ARE in the array return -1 (not found) when they should return the correct index. The implementation compiles without errors, so the bug is a logic error, not a syntax error. Use IntelliJ's debugger to set breakpoints, step through the search() method, and observe the loop variables to identify exactly why the method exits early. Fix the root cause so that all 9 tests in BinarySearchTest pass. Do not change the test file.

metadata.bug_description: Loop condition 'left < right' should be 'left <= right'
